caption: The drawing features three objects arranged on a plain, beige background. At the top center of the composition, there is a detailed, colored rendering of a chalice-like, goblet-shaped wooden object with a wide shallow bowl, a narrow neck, and a rounded, flared base. The object has a smooth surface with realistic wood grain, featuring shades of brown and yellowish-brown, with areas highlighting the glossy curvature and variations in the wood texture. Below this object, in the lower left quadrant, is a light graphite sketch of a round, flat-based disc with a slightly domed top and small perforations on its surface, suggesting it is a lid or cover. In the lower right quadrant, there is another graphite sketch of the same goblet-shaped object depicted above, showing only the outline and contours without color or texture. To the right of this second sketch, the name "Renée A. Monfalcone" is written neatly in cursive.
title: Sand Shaker
